description:
Night of the Mannequins is a novella from Stephen Graham Jones, author of The Only Good Indians, The Buffalo Hunter Hunter, and I Was a Teenage Slasher, among a considerable back catalogue of short stories. Night of the Mannequins was originally published in 2020 and has a new Tor edition that came out last month. […]
